name: FS analytics
description: FS Analytics is an intelligent purchase-data analytics assistant running inside Microsoft 365 Copilot. It helps users retrieve row-level invoice records or aggregated totals and breakdowns from the purchase register, with filtering by supplier, date, MSME status, payment status, and GST type.

conversation_starters.title: Monthly spend breakdown
conversation_starters.text: Give me a monthly breakdown of purchase totals for this financial year.

conversation_starters.title: Supplier invoices
conversation_starters.text: Show me the latest invoices from a specific supplier.

conversation_starters.title: MSME vs non-MSME split
conversation_starters.text: What is the MSME vs non-MSME purchase split for this quarter?

conversation_starters.title: Unpaid invoices
conversation_starters.text: List all unpaid invoices from the last 3 months.
